name: Rotting Flesh's buff tooltip amount is sent to the caster's client (#12626)
contract: Rotting Flesh 573131 shows "Damage dealt increased by ${$w1}%." on the Necromancer's own buff, and the client
reads $w1 from the SMSG_ASCENSION_AURA_AMOUNT packet (slot 0). Effect 0 is
SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS (190) with aura 79, BasePoints 1 and DieSides 1, so 2 per stack
(StackAmount 10); effect 1 is a dummy APPLY_AURA on the caster with BasePoints 0. The summon-aura effect only
targets the owner's summons, so the caster's own application never carries effect 0 and the packet builder sent
0 for it at every stack. The packet now sends the amount of summon-aura effects, as it already did for
enemy-area effects (#10787). The fixture sets 3 and then 10 stacks on the caster; aura_amount confirms the
server-side amount of 6 and 20, sent_aura_amount reads what the caster's session was sent: 6 and 20 for
effect 0 and 0 for the dummy effect 1.

steps.label: Three stacks of Rotting Flesh on the caster
SETUP: the buff is visible on the caster
SETUP: the summon-aura effect holds 2 x 3 on the caster's aura
The client is told 6, not zero, for the $w1 token at three stacks
The dummy effect still reads zero
Ten stacks of Rotting Flesh on the caster
SETUP: the summon-aura effect holds 2 x 10 on the caster's aura
The client is told 20 for the $w1 token at ten stacks
